card.name: Linking words before organ-involvement lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right before a list of affected organs or systems, such as brain, kidney or nervous system. Seen in descriptions of TTP, TMA, HUS and Lyme disease.

modes.label: Characterized by lists
modes.description: The word 'by' or a comma inside a symptom list for TTP that goes on to name neurological and renal problems.
modes.example: TTP is characterized<< by>> thrombocytopenia, micro

modes.label: Verbs before organ targets
modes.description: A verb such as 'affect' or 'include' that introduces the body systems or signs involved.
modes.example: which can<< affect>> the joints, heart and nervous system of

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for organs and the nervous system, such as brain, organ, organs and neurological.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a text names which organs or the nervous system a condition affects.
